column1: # CASE321_TOOLS.tsv: the tool versions that emitted the cases I and I13 packages of the final set (I.321, I13.L000 to I13.L078, I13.J).
# Each tool column gives the first 16 hex digits of the sha256 of the version that emitted the package: for the binaries, the production
# binary; for the scripts, the file in this repository (generators/caseII/), which reproduces the production output as stated in column verified.
# The production copies of the scripts were not archived with the packages; mkaggf.py's production version is identified by reproduction (below).
# Tools (column: path or binary, full sha256, role):

#   prof7R3q_b14: binary prof7R3q_b14, cab7182cc62093b80abb0e097f0ef57d28c4e78e4c11f758031cde22986517ba; the queue search; production binary (BINARIES.sha256), from search/src/xq/r3q/prof7R3q.cc and search/build.sh (a rebuild differs in bytes: the binary embeds its build paths)
#   recipe_321.txt: tools/case321/recipe_321.txt, 9dc9778e65c8b8e193ba0fbccf9b4fb8934ee3d928423fd6f817b47deb3faab3; the queue run's flags
#   splitpkg.py: tools/case321/splitpkg.py, 398d495adeea78fa5c553224bd9c724053c1106b5f2a6614d0ef95214384bab4; the I13 split (leaves and join)
#   xqitems.py: bundle/r22/lean/kinds/py/xqitems.py, 3d375413942971228c483c6c7c3f264169462b1a9406339ffab5b10e72c23569; item extraction from the queue run
#   r3qglue: binary r3qglue, 5d82fdccfb733be2dcb4696c9a77a06f6a10e19533cbd60ddb31b4ca5e5f391e; production binary (BINARIES.sha256); the build here is byte-identical

#   gen7c: binary gen7c, a2777304579233ffbdeed95d84ca99ac6b1212f3605af6454ec4e29098ea3659; production binary (BINARIES.sha256), from search/src/gen7c/gen7c.cc (the build here gives the same certificates)
#   mkimod321.py: tools/case321/mkimod321.py, e1f926eeabf17643a5a333f6ca6adbce1b27940f7f9c92921bd8502f10cf350b; item modules and the root 462
#   mkslice2.py: bundle/r22/lean/kinds/py/mkslice2.py, 2597acaec3c8b450a770ec8c31d37c6217e8dc7055dfa6e92257d2805f1a3ab9; item grouping (with mkimod.py's cost and peak models)
#   mkimod.py: bundle/r22/lean/kinds/py/mkimod.py, 31a908db95989c1257b130e565874223ab8c4f57b18b5551623c0dc8b5d05618; models read by mkslice2.py

#   mkaggf.py: tools/case321/mkaggf.py, 692a00fd1eb43954e211e8361b2be21db306b534d4e7fcf39a960283266a5299; chunks, export maps and tops: the production version 298a682196fe773c5678b83d44c24edfd313cf75af4d4b466a9f9e77bb8f1e9d with its default path replaced, the same file as bundle/versions/d4258187d500b0d1/r22/lean/kinds/py/mkaggf.py; it writes no deny-list line, unlike the bundle's mkaggf.py

#   mkpkg2.py: tools/case321/mkpkg2.py, 69ec06e37e740ad0d2e4ec0935a6b82db5deec3a90da67cba193fad1b29bbd4c; packaging (the packages' kmod_unit.sh, README.txt and lpath_common.txt carry placeholders and neutral wording where the production packages have paths)

#   kmod_build.sh: bundle/r22/lean/leaf2/kmod/tools/kmod_build.sh, 24163fcaab078ad137b0824ca8fb0d3777179ec26e66f4039e2f1918072a1995; the packages' unit builder (the production packages' copy differs only in its default lean path)
# Column mkstage321: the arguments of tools/case321/mkstage321.sh (PREFIX LO HI ITEMDIR MAXS FANIN, with its environment); for I13,
# Column verified: "staging" = mkstage321.sh's staging step (mkimod321.py for the root 462, mkslice2.py, mkaggf.py) re-run with these
# scripts on the package's own item dirs (data/q/*.d) gives every module source, spec, export map and wave of the package byte for byte;
# "manifest.tsv identical", or "manifest.tsv column 6 differs": the item modules' predicted peak GB, which the production I13 emission computed
# with mkimod321.py's peak model before its widening (the packages' manifest.jsonl pred_gb were recomputed with the widened model before
# the production build); "pipeline" = the whole I13 pipeline from the production queue run's plan and segments (splitrun.py) gives every
# item dir and module source byte for byte (the pre-registered re-check, manifests/sample_check/).
